definitions.explanation: The practice of consuming food and goods that are produced locally. A movement promoting the use of locally sourced products to support regional economies and reduce environmental impact.

examples.japanese: {地産地消|ちさんちしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I make an effort to buy locally produced goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地産地消|ちさんちしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわっている→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant is committed to using locally sourced ingredients.

examples.japanese: {地産地消|ちさんちしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Efforts toward local production for local consumption are spreading across the country.

notes:
{地産地消|ちさんちしょう} is an abbreviation of ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{消費|しょうひ}→消費：03240_shouhi⟧ (regional production, regional consumption). It is composed of {地|ち} (local) + {産|さん} (production) + {地|ち} (local) + {消|しょう} (consumption).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地産地消|ちさんちしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}する→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧: to promote local consumption of local products
- {地産地消|ちさんちしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧: efforts toward local production/consumption
- {地産地消|ちさんちしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧: to be particular about local sourcing

CULTURAL NOTE: This concept is widely promoted in Japan through farmers' markets (⟦{直売所|ちょくばいじょ}→直売所：13746_chokubaijo⟧), school lunch programs, and restaurant branding. It is associated with freshness, supporting local farmers, and reducing food miles.
